title: Guinness Brewery, St. James’s Gate
axis: Positive X follows the entrance frontage westward. Positive Z points to the footway leading to James’s Street.

mappedIdentity.name: Guinness Brewery, St. James’s Gate
mappedIdentity.address: St. James’s Gate, Thomas Street at James’s Street, Dublin 8, Ireland

features.role: Mapped footprint of the east gate lodge, with the gate node and two lodge outlines driving the exterior.

identityStatus: The NIAH identifies the main entrance and paired lodges as one architectural group. The named gate and two matching building footprints supply the coordinate, north-facing axis, width and depths.

terrainContact.basis: Unmodified Copernicus GLO-30 at the gateway entrance. Lodge foundations continue below this grade to accommodate the mapped road slope.

notes: The original Commons CC0 close photograph gives the gate opening proportions, granite surrounds, render, door design, sign position, parapet, date panels and east lodge return. The official inventory records the three-storey lodges, sash types, hipped roof fronts and east chimney.
